passages.title: Message in a Bottle
passages.text: Help! Our ship, Sethraliss's Scale, has run aground. We are on an island east of Zul'Aman. Send help and you can have the cargo we saved. Captain Lenta.

passages.title: Message in a Bottle
passages.text: The bottle came back. Again. I've thrown it out to sea on the tide. This makes no sense. If you find this, tell a tortollan sailor. They will know who I am. We still have plenty of cargo to reward you if you come and rescue us. Captain Lenta.

passages.title: Message in a Bottle
passages.text: This bottle won't stop returning. This island is haunted and infested with snakes. We would still like to be rescued, but I understand if you stay far away from here. All we have found are wrecks of Zandalari ships. I should never have purchased a Zandalari ship. Whatever has cursed this island does not like the Zandalari. Can't it see I'm a tortollan? I hope this bottle floats away this time. Captain Lenta.

passages.title: Message in a Bottle
passages.text: Captain Lenta was bitten by a snake. Don't come here. This island is a cage. Swabby Wuck.
